_readme: Combat tuning knobs. Change a number, save, restart the game (server AND clients read the same file). Set a value back to its 'neutral' number to undo it. Anything missing or invalid falls back to neutral.

_help.player_hit_bonus: Flat percentage points added to a PLAYER's melee hit chance. Neutral 0. (Hit chance = attack - target armor + level difference x hit_level_diff_per_level + random 0-20 + this bonus, then clamped to hit_min..hit_max.)
_help.monster_hit_bonus: Same, for MONSTERS attacking. Neutral 0. Raise it to make monsters hit you more often.
_help.hit_level_diff_per_level: Hit chance points per level of difference between attacker and target. Neutral 5.
_help.hit_min: Lowest hit chance any attack can have, in percent. Neutral 5.
_help.hit_max: Highest hit chance any attack can have, in percent. Neutral 95.
_help.player_melee_damage_mult: Multiplier on the damage of a player's melee hits. Neutral 1.0.
_help.monster_melee_damage_mult: Multiplier on the damage of monsters' melee hits. Neutral 1.0.
_help.player_spell_damage_mult: Multiplier on the damage of spells cast by players. Neutral 1.0. (0.5 halves them.)
_help.monster_hp_mult: Multiplier on every monster's HP, before level scaling. Neutral 1.0.
_help.monster_hp_per_level: HP gained per level ABOVE the monster's base level in monsters.json (and lost per level below), as a fraction: 0.12 = +12% per level. Neutral 0 (level then only changes attack/armor).
_help.monster_scale_min: Level scaling never takes HP/damage below this multiple. Neutral 0.5.
